company.shortDescription: Akudo is a learning-first neobank enabling practical financial education for teenagers.
company.description: Akudo is a learning-first neobank for teenagers. Akudo provides personalised debit cards that can be used by them independently, with the aim to help them save money, and gives them exciting rewards under a gamified setup when they're good at their personal finance.
